category_title: Grade 1 students who resist collaboration and require one-to-one guidance
minimal_context: Kylie is assigned independent math problems to solve at her desk during a Grade 1 mathematics class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please work on the next three math problems independently at your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits at her desk, looking away from the paper and quietly singing to herself instead of starting the math problems.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Kylie, please focus on your assignment and try to solve the first problem.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Quickly writes down a number without showing any work, focused only on the end product, and points to it.) Is this right?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you explain to the class how you figured that out?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Refuses to volunteer her solution or explain her process, looks down, and goes back to playing alone and singing quietly until she is given step-by-step guidance.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please work on the next three math problems independently at your desk.

STUDENT: (Sits at her desk, looking away from the paper and quietly singing to herself instead of starting the math problems.)

TUTOR: Kylie, please focus on your assignment and try to solve the first problem.

STUDENT: (Quickly writes down a number without showing any work, focused only on the end product, and points to it.) Is this right?

TUTOR: Can you explain to the class how you figured that out?

STUDENT: (Refuses to volunteer her solution or explain her process, looks down, and goes back to playing alone and singing quietly until she is given step-by-step guidance.)

task.content: Engage in assigned independent tasks and consider solution processes during whole-class discussions

context.social_setting: Individual learning setting and whole-class discussions

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When assigned an independent task without immediate teacher attention
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Frequently observed playing alone or singing to herself, engaged in solitary activity that was often off-task, and would not engage in the assigned task.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Had difficulty with persistence and academic stamina; preferred the individual learning setting but did not actually 'work' independently.

behavior_patterns.condition: During whole-class discussions where students were encouraged to consider process
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Refrained from participating in class discussion, did not volunteer solutions even if she had one, and often asked the teacher, 'Is this right?'
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Focused on the end product rather than the process, seemed more concerned with getting teacher approval, and regarded the teacher as the only legitimate source of information.
